root_facts: Signed webhook bytes, provider event identity, role-local identity-flow input, review command version and provider outcome faults.
forbidden_direct_seed: webhook inbox status, identity-binding status, review decision, delivery task status, delivery attempt or provider publication result
commands: Accept and replay a webhook event, validate a one-use identity flow, decide a pending review and dispatch a claimed delivery task.
Inject timeout, rate-limit and accepted-retry provider responses through the adapter.
expected: Provider event identity or canonical fallback fingerprint makes identical webhook input replay-safe.
Identity flows reject another user, expiry and reuse; only a capability-bearing actor can approve a pending review and bind the resolved role-local owner.
Delivery state changes use a lease, bounded exponential retry and terminal failure after the configured maximum attempts.
The worker commits the claim before the provider call, then records the provider outcome in a separate transaction.
Provider timeout and rate limiting remain typed retryable outcomes, while an accepted retry key maps to one successful provider result.
receipt_requirements: identity-flow, review capability and binding assertions
